techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Voice
techniques.how: Calls the IT help desk posing as an employee to reset a password or move MFA to an attacker device
coverage: NEW (partial): entra_new_mfa_method.yml catches the MFA re-registration that follows a help-desk reset

techniques.name: Phishing (SMS)
techniques.how: SMS lures to lookalike SSO pages (e.g. <company>-helpdesk / oktalogin-<company> domains)
coverage: Lookalike / homoglyph link detection in the phishing analyzer (email lures; SMS not covered)

techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Domains
coverage: Lookalike / homoglyph domain scoring

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
techniques.how: Logs in with stolen or reset employee credentials
coverage: IR success-after-failures (likely compromised account)
CLD-013 impossible travel

techniques.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation
techniques.how: MFA push bombing until the user approves
coverage: CLD-011 MFA fatigue (Sigma event_count)

techniques.name: Modify Authentication Process: Multi-Factor Authentication
techniques.how: Registers its own MFA device on the compromised account
coverage: NEW: Sigma entra_new_mfa_method.yml

techniques.name: Domain or Tenant Policy Modification: Trust Modification
techniques.how: Adds a federated identity provider to the tenant for persistent SSO access
coverage: NEW: Sigma entra_federation_change.yml

techniques.name: Create Account
techniques.how: Creates new identities, sometimes backed by fake social-media profiles
coverage: IR-005 new local/domain account created (4720, useradd)
CLD-006 console password created for IAM user

techniques.name: Remote Access Tools
techniques.how: Installs legitimate RMM / remote tools: AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, TeamViewer, Splashtop, Tactical.RMM, Teleport, Ngrok, Tailscale
coverage: NEW: Sigma rmm_tool_execution.yml (written to close this gap)

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
techniques.how: Mimikatz and similar tools after gaining a foothold
coverage: DF-11 LSASS memory dump (comsvcs MiniDump / procdump)

techniques.name: Data from Information Repositories: SharePoint
techniques.how: Searches SharePoint and wikis for VPN, MFA and help-desk procedures

techniques.name: Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure: Create Cloud Instance
techniques.how: Creates EC2 instances to move laterally inside cloud environments
coverage: CLD-008 EC2 launched in unapproved region

techniques.name: Data from Cloud Storage
techniques.how: Pulls data from cloud storage and SaaS data platforms (e.g. Snowflake bulk queries)
coverage: CLD-007 S3 bucket opened to everyone
Bulk-read detection via database audit trail

techniques.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
techniques.how: Exfiltrates to MEGA and attacker-controlled Amazon S3
coverage: NET-003 large outbound transfer to an external destination (Zeek)

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
techniques.how: Abuses or disables EDR and cloud security tooling
coverage: CLD-003 CloudTrail stopped; CLD-004 GuardDuty deleted

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.how: Deploys ALPHV/BlackCat and, more recently, DragonForce ransomware, including against VMware ESXi
coverage: Mass file-rename and ransom-note detection (case IR-2026-1027)
YARA Ransom_Note_Generic

techniques.name: Financial Theft
techniques.how: Data-theft extortion, threatening to publish stolen data
coverage: Tabletop injects 5-6: notification and payment decision
